title: When Agentic Retrieval Fails Silently: Framework and Production Evidence from a Creative AI Assistant
abstract: arXiv:2610.30423v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: CTR, MRR, and behavioral NDCG assume the user sees ranked results and acts on them. In an agentic assistant, a generation layer consumes retrieval output first, and that assumption breaks in three ways. The agent reads the results before the user does (who). The user's action can come several turns or sessions after retrieval (when). Outcomes blend retrieved content with the model's own knowledge (what caused it). We call this the attribution gap. We propose Layered Agentic Retrieval Assessment (LARA), which measures retrieval quality, engagement and outcome, and product success as three independent layers joined by a four-field lineage schema that requires no new modeling. We examine the motivation on Adobe Express, where one retrieval infrastructure serves a gallery search surface and an agentic assistant at roughly one-eighth its session volume for the same user population. Chat users reformulate more than gallery users (44.4% vs. 33.

translated_title: 当智能体式检索悄然失效时：来自创意AI助手的框架与生产环境证据
translated_abstract: CTR（点击率）、MRR（平均倒数排名）和行为NDCG等指标均假设用户会看到排序后的结果并据此采取行动。而在智能体式助手（agentic assistant）中，生成层会首先消费检索输出，这一假设在三个方面被打破：智能体先于用户读取检索结果（“谁”）；用户的行动可能发生在检索之后的数轮对话或多个会话（“何时”）；最终结果融合了检索内容与模型自身的知识（“何因”）。我们将这一现象称为“归因鸿沟”（attribution gap）。我们提出分层智能体检索评估框架（LARA），将检索质量、参与度与结果、产品成功作为三个相互独立的层级加以测量，并通过一个四字段的溯源模式（lineage schema）将各层连接起来，且无需引入新的建模。我们在Adobe Express上对这一动机进行了考察：同一套检索基础设施同时服务于画廊搜索界面与智能体式助手，后者面向相同的用户群体，但会话量仅约为前者的八分之一。聊天用户的查询重述比例高于画廊用户（44.4% 对 33……
tldr: 该论文指出传统检索评估指标（CTR、MRR、行为NDCG）在智能体助手中因“归因鸿沟”而悄然失效，并提出无需新增建模的LARA框架，通过检索质量、参与与结果、产品成功三个独立层级以及四字段溯源模式，在生产环境Adobe Express中评估智能体式检索的真实效果。
en_tdlr: Traditional retrieval metrics (CTR, MRR, behavioral NDCG) silently fail in agentic assistants due to the "attribution gap"; the paper proposes LARA, a framework requiring no new modeling that measures retrieval quality, engagement/outcome, and product success as three independent layers linked by a four-field lineage schema, validated in production on Adobe Express.
